correctness.rationale: The exact degree-two Bernoulli expansion, orthogonality, squared-gap identity, and variance formulas are fully derived in RESULT.md. In the critical window, a connected joint-cumulant graph count gives O_k(n^(k+1)) versus n^(3k/2), with limiting variance 1/32+c²/12; off-window Lindeberg and an L²-small quadratic remainder complete the proof. Exact rational exhaustive checks on n=3..6 at four biases, 135,456 orientation states, passed. Finite tests do not prove the CLT.

value.rationale: Cycle count is a natural measure of intransitivity in Condorcet/noisy-ranking tournaments. The theorem proves a distinct bias-driven change in fluctuation order and an exact n^(-1/2) Gaussian crossover with coefficient 1/32+c²/12; this is a genuinely parameter-sensitive limit mechanism, not a numerical certificate, simple renaming, or unmotivated special graph slice.
